knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R Code/gc-processing/")

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(stringi)
library(broom)
library(reshape2)
source("function/convert_ppm_min_flux.R")
```

```{r}
files <- list.files("data/tidy/250314", pattern = "ppm")
ghg_ppm <- lapply(paste0("data/tidy/250314/", files), read_csv) %>% bind_rows()
ghg_ppm
```

```{r}
min_elapsed <- read_csv("data/tidy/250314/250314_min_elapsed.csv")
ghg_ppm <- ghg_ppm %>% 
  mutate(ecosystem = case_when(
    grepl("P", rep) ~ paste0(ecosystem, "P"),
    TRUE ~ ecosystem
  )) %>% 
  mutate(rep = str_remove(rep, "P")) %>% 
  separate(rep, c("pref", "suff"), "-") %>% 
  mutate(pref = as.numeric(pref),
         suff = as.numeric(suff)) %>% 
  left_join(min_elapsed, by = c("ecosystem", "pref", "suff", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(date_collected = "250314",
         ecosystem = case_when(
           is.na(pref) ~ paste0(ecosystem, "P"),
           TRUE ~ ecosystem
         ))
ghg_ppm


# ghg_ppm <- ghg_ppm %>%
#   filter(filename!="t4_20250314_010")
```
### CO2 - Prairie

visualize linear co2 fits

```{r}
ghg_ppm %>% 
  filter(ecosystem == "Pr") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = min_elapsed, y = co2_ppm)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  facet_wrap(~ecosystem+pref+suff, 
             scales = "fixed") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text.x = element_blank()
)
ggsave("data/diagnostics/250314_prairie_co2_lm.png")
```

fit linear co2 models

```{r}
ghg_ppm %>%
    filter(ecosystem %in% c("Pr", "NWd", "SWd", "Wt")) %>% 
    ## Code to filter out bad time points
  # mutate(
  #   co2_ppm = case_when(
  #   ecosystem == "NWd" & pref == 3 & suff %in% c(1, 2) & timepoint == "t3" ~ NA,
  #   TRUE ~ co2_ppm),
  #) %>% 
  nest_by(ecosystem, pref, suff) %>% 
  mutate(lm_co2 = list(lm(co2_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data)),
         lm_ch4 = list(lm(ch4_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data)),
         lm_n2o = list(lm(n2o_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data))) %>%
  summarize(tidy(lm_co2)) %>% 
  filter(term == "min_elapsed") %>% 
  write_csv("data/final/250314/250314_co2_fluxes.csv")
```

## get fluxes to plot

```{r read}
co2 <- read_csv("data/final/250314/250314_co2_fluxes.csv") %>% 
  mutate(gas = "co2")
ch4 <- read_csv("data/final/250314/250314_ch4_fluxes.csv") %>% 
  mutate(gas = "ch4")
n2o <- read_csv("data/final/250314/250314_n2o_fluxes.csv") %>% 
  mutate(gas = "n2o")
```

get chamber temps and vols

```{r chamber-temps}
chamber_temps <- read_csv("data/tidy/250314/250314_chamber_temps.csv")
chamber_vols <- read_csv("data/tidy/2024_chamber_vols.csv")
```


merge and convert units

```{r merge}
fluxes <- co2 %>% bind_rows(ch4) %>% bind_rows(n2o) %>% 
  select(ecosystem, pref, suff, gas, estimate, p.value) %>% 
  left_join(chamber_temps, by = c("ecosystem", "pref", "suff")) %>% 
  select(-temp_start, -temp_end) %>% 
  left_join(chamber_vols, by = c("ecosystem", "pref", "suff")) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(flux = convert_ppm_min_flux(gas, estimate, total_vol_m3, average_temp_kelvin)) %>% 
  mutate(units = ifelse(gas == "co2", "umol_m2_s1", NA),
         units = ifelse(gas == "ch4", "nmol_m2_s1", units),
         units = ifelse(gas == "n2o", "nmol_m2_s1", units))
fluxes
```

save final flux data

```{r}
write_csv(fluxes, "data/final/250314/250314_fluxes.csv")
```
